text: Ich bin insgesamt ausgeglichener und schlafe besser. Ich habe auch wieder mehr Freude an Dingen außerhalb der Arbeit, z.B. am Kochen und an Ausflügen mit meinem Freund. Früher war ich abends nur noch erschöpft und habe mich vor den Fernseher gesetzt. Heute habe ich das Gefühl, wieder ein Leben neben dem Job zu haben, und dafür bin ich sehr dankbar.
Calmer mind

It's hard to separate the effects of the experience from everything that's happened since, but I'd say my mental health has held up remarkably well under circumstances that would have broken me before. The main thing is that I feel a deep love for my partner and for life that carries me. During the experience, I felt that love is the ground we stand on, and that everything else is weather. I still feel that. When I'm with my partner on a hard day, when her legs don't work or she's exhausted, I feel sad, but I also feel this enormous tenderness and gratitude that we have each other. I appreciate small things so much more: a good day when she has energy, a walk together, a meal with friends. I've had moments of despair, of course, but I haven't fallen into depression, which I've had twice in my life before. I think the experience gave me a kind of foundation, and the people around me have built on it.
Ich bin entspannter und habe weniger Angst vor der Zukunft. Das tut mir gut.
I'm more emotionally stable and my relationships are better because of it. I don't feel guilty all the time for blowing up at people.

My mental health improved quite a lot after the experience, though not in a dramatic way. I'd been running on adrenaline and anxiety for most of my career and I didn't even realise how bad it was until it stopped. In the months after, I noticed that I slept better, I didn't have stomach problems anymore, and I could enjoy a weekend without checking email every hour. More fundamentally, I feel like I've got my sense of self back, separate from my job. I'm a father, a friend, a gardener, a bad but enthusiastic tennis player. I appreciate those parts of my life much more now. I've also become more open to different ways of working and living. I used to think the only path was to keep pushing until I got a professorship, and now I'm genuinely open to other options, which feels incredibly freeing. I'm much happier than I was, and my family says I'm more present.
Auch hier keine Veränderung, würde ich sagen.
I'm less anxious and more relaxed. I don't feel the constant urge to fix everything.

My mental health has improved because I'm no longer carrying my parents' problems. I used to feel responsible for their happiness, which made me anxious and depressed. Now I see that I can love them without fixing them. I feel lighter and more free, and I have more energy for my own life. I've also become more compassionate towards both of them, which has made our relationships better even though they're struggling.

In den ersten Monaten nach der Erfahrung ging es mir psychisch schlechter, ich war unruhig und hatte Schlafprobleme. Danach hat es sich wieder eingependelt, und heute würde ich sagen, die Erfahrung hatte langfristig keinen großen Einfluss auf meine psychische Gesundheit.

My mental health has changed significantly since the experience. I've had generalized anxiety since my late teens, and it shaped my whole life. I avoided travel, I turned down promotions, I was always the one who stayed home. After the experience the anxiety didn't disappear, but it became something I could live with instead of something that ran my life. I've reduced my medication with my psychiatrist's support, and I'm doing well. More than that, I feel a kind of tenderness toward myself that I didn't have before. I used to hate my anxiety and therefore hate myself. Now I see it as a sensitive part of me that needs care. I've also become more open to life. I went on my first trip abroad in ten years last spring, to Portugal, and I loved it. I appreciate so many things now that I used to be too scared to enjoy. I'm genuinely happy most days, which I couldn't say before.
A little better

Ich habe gelernt, meine Gefühle aus einer gewissen Distanz zu betrachten, und das hat mir geholfen, nicht mehr so stark von ihnen beherrscht zu werden. Ich bin psychisch stabiler und weniger ängstlich. Manchmal fühle ich mich allerdings auch etwas distanziert von allem, das ist der Nachteil.

I've become much kinder to myself, and that has improved my mental health more than I can say. I used to have very low self-esteem and a constant inner critic. Since the experience I'm more gentle and accepting. I have fewer depressive episodes, and when I do feel low, I don't make it worse by attacking myself. I feel more love for myself, which is something I never thought I'd say. I've also become more open with my friends about my struggles, and that has made me feel less alone.
No change either
Ich habe mehr Selbstvertrauen und bin weniger unsicher. Das hat meine Stimmung deutlich verbessert. Ich traue mir mehr zu, sowohl beruflich als auch privat, und habe weniger Angst, Fehler zu machen.

My mental health is much better since I stopped running from myself. I used to have periods of burnout and depression every year or so, usually after months of overworking and overdrinking. Since the experience I haven't had one, and it's been almost three years. I'm more emotionally honest, I feel my feelings, and that keeps them from building up. I've also become much more appreciative of quiet and simple things. I used to be bored and restless whenever I wasn't busy, and now I can enjoy a slow morning or an evening reading. I'm more open to my own inner world, my dreams, my intuitions, which I used to dismiss. And I've found that I'm actually good company for myself, which I never believed before. I'm much happier now, though it's a quieter kind of happiness than I expected.
Less lonely and more supported
Ich bin weniger gereizt und kann mich besser selbst regulieren. Unsere Beziehung ist dadurch harmonischer geworden, und ich fühle mich glücklicher und ausgeglichener.

My mental health has improved, mainly because I reconnected with meaning in my work. I'd been sliding into cynicism and depression, and I'd started to dread going to the hospital. Now I feel more purpose and more gratitude for the privilege of being able to help people. I'm also more open to talking about mental health with my colleagues, and I've joined a peer support programme for doctors. I still get tired, but I'm not burnt out anymore.
More confident in myself
Ich bin weniger ängstlich und kann klarer denken. Insgesamt fühle ich mich psychisch stabiler und sicherer.
Less anger, more peace. My mood is better and I'm a better dad.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung deutlich verbessert, auch wenn es ein langer Weg war. Ich leide seit meiner Jugend an einer posttraumatischen Belastungsstörung, und die Erstarrung, die ich bei Stress erlebe, war nur ein Teil davon. Ich hatte auch Albträume, Flashbacks und war oft wochenlang wie betäubt. Nach der Erfahrung sind die Albträume seltener geworden, und ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich mehr in meinem Körper bin. Ich kann wieder Freude empfinden, was lange nicht möglich war. Ich verstehe auch besser, was in mir passiert, wenn ich getriggert werde, und habe Werkzeuge, um damit umzugehen. Die Traumatherapie, die ich nach der Erfahrung begonnen habe, ist anstrengend, aber ich merke Fortschritte. Ich bin dankbar, dass ich diesen Weg gehen kann, und habe zum ersten Mal Hoffnung, dass ich irgendwann ein Leben ohne ständige Angst führen kann.
Mehr Ruhe und weniger Stress
I'm less anxious and more relaxed now that I've let go of perfectionism. I enjoy my life more and I'm kinder to myself.

I feel more hopeful and resilient, and I've had fewer depressive episodes. I see life as a journey with ups and downs, and that helps me not to give up when things are hard. I'm also more grateful for the good times, because I know they won't last forever, and that makes them sweeter. My mother's death was the hardest thing I've ever been through, but I didn't fall apart, and I think that's thanks to the perspective I gained.
Ich bin insgesamt ruhiger und zufriedener geworden. Ich habe weniger Angst und genieße mein Leben mehr.
I'm more emotionally stable and I feel more secure in myself

The experience was a turning point in my mental health. I had been depressed on and off for almost ten years, mostly since my brother died. I had never really grieved him. I had gone numb, and the numbness spread to everything. I couldn't feel joy, love, or even proper sadness. During the experience the numbness lifted, and I grieved him for the first time, for hours. It was the most painful and also the most healing thing I've ever experienced. Since then I've been able to feel again. Sometimes it's overwhelming, but mostly it's wonderful. I feel love for my partner and my friends that I hadn't felt in years. I can laugh properly. I appreciate being alive, which I honestly didn't for a long time. My depression isn't completely gone, and I'm still in therapy, but it's lighter, and I have hope now, which I didn't have before.
Etwas ausgeglichener, ansonsten wenig Veränderung.
I'm less anxious and more present, and I enjoy life more. I notice things I used to miss.

I'm much less anxious and more confident since I stopped seeing failure as the end of the world. I was always afraid of trying new things in case I failed, and now I'm more open to taking risks. I started learning the piano at 34 and I'm terrible at it and I love it. I feel happier and freer than I have in years.
Ich bin psychisch stabiler und ausgeglichener geworden. Ich habe weniger Ängste und kann besser mit meinen Gefühlen umgehen. Ich bin auch offener für andere Menschen und ihre Sichtweisen.
I can't say it had a big impact. I felt good for a few days after.

My mental health has improved a lot, mainly because I'm not so anxious and controlling anymore. I used to have a lot of anxiety about things going wrong, and I spent a huge amount of energy trying to prevent every possible problem. It was exhausting, and it made me tense and irritable. Since the experience, I've been much more relaxed. I can enjoy things even when they don't go to plan. The wedding was a perfect example: everything went wrong, and it was one of the happiest days of my life. I feel so much love for my wife, my friends and my family, and I'm more open to life's surprises. I also understand myself better. I see that my need for control came from growing up in a chaotic household, and that I don't need it anymore. That understanding has given me a lot of peace.
Ich bin seit der Erfahrung ängstlicher und habe manchmal Panikattacken, die ich vorher nicht hatte.

I'm much less resentful and exhausted, and I feel more like myself. I understand now that I was abandoning my own needs to please others, and that it was making me unhappy. Setting boundaries has improved my mental health a lot. I'm less anxious, less depressed, and I respect myself more.
Honestly I don't feel much about anything anymore, stress or otherwise. It's fine.
Ich achte besser auf mich und meine Bedürfnisse. Dadurch geht es mir psychisch besser, und ich bin seltener erschöpft oder niedergeschlagen.
